_comment: Concept: setup-reversal. The hook promises a sweet dog and withholds the 24th hour, then the footage is the answer. Captions form one escalating sentence - sheep, then rug, then me, then you - instead of narrating each clip. The last clip charges the lens, so 'THEN YOU' breaks the fourth wall and loops back into the hook.

segments._note: c2 portrait: big expressive face, paws at the sheep
c3: zoomies on the rug with the yellow ball
c5: 11.9-13.6 is the run at camera, ending on a full-frame face. Past 13.8 it degrades to motion blur, so this stays at one bar.

captions.text: this is not the same dog
